    Ring Size Guide

    Not sure of your size? Measure at home with a strip of paper or string, then match your measurement (in mm) to the chart below.

    IndiaUSUKDiameter (mm)
    84H14.9
    105J½15.7
    126L½16.5
    147N½17.3
    168P½18.1
    189R½18.9
    1. Wrap a thin strip of paper or string around the base of your finger.
    2. Mark where the string overlaps, then measure the length in millimetres.
    3. Divide by 3.14 to get the diameter, and match it to the chart above.

    Jewellery Care Guide

    Kundan, polki and temple jewellery are delicate by nature — a little care keeps them glowing for generations.

    1. Put your jewellery on last — after perfume, hairspray and lotion — to avoid dulling the stones.
    2. Store each piece separately in a soft cloth pouch to prevent scratching between metals and stones.
    3. Wipe gently with a dry, soft cloth after wear; avoid water and ultrasonic cleaners on kundan and polki settings.
    4. For gold-plated pieces, avoid direct sunlight and humid storage to slow natural tarnishing.
